items.text: Since its discovery, food businesses have encouraged high-protein diets, according to research by the University of Oregon.
Whether it's bars, shakes or even marshmallows, protein has always prevailed in conversations about health and fitness.

level1.label: 让步状语从句
level1.text: Whether it's bars, shakes or even marshmallows

items.text: Some people think that these kinds of diets are a fad because high-protein products appear on supermarket shelves often.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that these kinds of diets are a fad because high-protein products appear on supermarket shelves often

level2.label: 原因状语从句
level2.text: because high-protein products appear on supermarket shelves often

items.text: However, these diets have slightly stagnated within the realm of wellness.
And that's because there's now another food group gaining popularity - fibre.

level1.label: 表语从句
level1.text: because there's now another food group gaining popularity

items.text: Found in foods like fruits, vegetables, grains, nuts, seeds, and legumes, our enzymes can't break down fibre into nutrients to absorb like it would with other food groups.

level1.label: 状语
level1.text: Found in foods like fruits, vegetables, grains, nuts, seeds, and legumes

level1.label: 状语从句
level1.text: like it would with other food groups

items.text: Instead, it passes through the digestive system, which helps regulate bowel movements.
Multiple studies have shown that certain types of fibre can lower cholesterol, help manage blood sugar levels and improve general gut health.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that certain types of fibre can lower cholesterol, help manage blood sugar levels and improve general gut health

items.text: It can also help you feel fuller for longer as it takes more time to digest.

level1.label: 原因状语从句
level1.text: as it takes more time to digest

items.text: The World Health Organisation recommends that adults consume 25-35g of fibre a day.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that adults consume 25-35g of fibre a day

items.text: However, research by Tate & Lyle between the years of 2021 and 2022 shows that adults in many countries aren't even close to that benchmark.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that adults in many countries aren't even close to that benchmark

items.text: The National Institute of Health tells us that the fibre intake in women is less than men.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that the fibre intake in women is less than men

items.text: Additionally, data from the World Health Organisation shows a trend that those living outside of cities, like villages and in the countryside, have lower fibre consumption in comparison to those who live in cities.

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: a trend that those living outside of cities, like villages and in the countryside, have lower fibre consumption in comparison to those who live in cities

level2.label: 同位语从句
level2.text: that those living outside of cities, like villages and in the countryside, have lower fibre consumption in comparison to those who live in cities

items.text: Studies have found that not eating enough fibre can have detrimental consequences on your health.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that not eating enough fibre can have detrimental consequences on your health

items.text: Without it, your gut bacteria can't fight excess inflammation, provide energy, or manage your blood sugar levels or your mood.

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: your blood sugar levels or your mood

items.text: Physically, you're more likely to be constipated and to feel sluggish and tired.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: more likely to be constipated and to feel sluggish and tired

items.text: So, what can you do?
Well, dieticians say that you should eat five to eight portions of fruit and vegetables a day.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that you should eat five to eight portions of fruit and vegetables a day

items.text: Try throwing in a handful of cooked lentils or chickpeas into curries, soups or salads.

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: throwing in a handful of cooked lentils or chickpeas

items.text: You can also eat seeds, nuts and dried fruit as your snack between meals.
It might feel fashionable to talk about fibre at the moment, but science suggests that we need it to be healthy.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that we need it to be healthy

items.text: So, be careful to follow dieticians' advice and try to eat your fruits and veggies!

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: to eat your fruits and veggies
